In compliance with the directions of the Commission, the petitioner has filed additional information and has served copies on the respondents. The respondent UPPCL, BRPL and TPDDL has filed the reply in the matter and the petitioner has also filed its rejoinder. The petitioner vide affidavit dated 4.5.2016 has submitted that the RCE with completion cost of `2290.02 crore has been approved by the Standing Committee and is pending before the Central Government for approval. Pending submission of approved RCE, we now proceed to examine the claim of the petitioner based on the submissions of the parties and the documents available on record, as discussed in the subsequent paragraphs. _Order in Petition No 250/GT/2014 Page 6 of 46_ 14.
